metric_reconciliation_table.discrepancy_root_cause: The discrepancy between 2.53% vs 4.22% avoided drawdown and 1.37% vs 1.84% reentry penalty originates from full-dataset pooling vs downtrend-regime filtering: 1. Across all 8,128 hypothetical exit observations (including ranges and uncertain regimes), the mean avoided drawdown was 2.53% and the mean reentry price disadvantage was 1.37%. 2. When isolating the DOWNTREND REGIME (TREND_DOWN) exits specifically, exiting protected against an average forward drawdown of 4.22%, but re-entering suffered an average penalty of 1.84% higher price. Both numbers are valid descriptions of their respective subsets.

hypothetical_vs_actual_exits_comparison.explanation: Hypothetical exits evaluate every sampled point as if the portfolio held BTC and was forced to consider exiting. Actual executed exits occurred only when the simulated portfolio was genuinely in a BTC position. Because the Patient Engine held BTC only 6.64% of the time, only 627 actual exits were executed.
